newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Mobile cuts cellular charges.
newsitem.headline: Korea Mobile cuts cellular charges.

text.p: Korea Mobile Telecom Co said on Monday it would cut service charges on its cellular phone services by an average of 12.6 percent effective December 1.
"We decided to lower the charges to meet the diversifying customer needs and to reflect improved management efficiency through competition," a statement from the company said.
Industry sources said the move was influenced by the recent sharp fee cut by the company's only rival, Shinsegi Telecomm Inc, for new subscribers.
On Saturday, Shinsegi cut the expense of deposits, sign-up fees and a handset to 360,000 won from around 700,000 won.
The statement said Korea Mobile also plans to diversify its service charge systems, giving frequent users fee reductions of up to 23.8 percent.
Korea Mobile held a monopoly in the domestic cellular phone services market until Shinsegi launched commercial services in April this year.
